content: Hello, I would like to place a delivery order, please.
Sure, what would you like to order today?
I would like to order two plates of chicken biryani and one raita, if you have it.
Got it—two chicken biryanis and one raita. Would you like anything else with your order?
No, that is everything. Also, could you please make it less spicy if possible?
We can certainly make it less spicy. May I have your delivery address, please?The total comes to Rs 2,200, and delivery will take about 45 minutes. Thank you for ordering from Karachi Kitchen!
My delivery address is House 12, Street 4, F-7/2, Islamabad, and my callback number is 0300-0000000.
